existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: `EpisodeOfCare` has hard local breaks despite stable canonical identity. Top concerns are subject renaming, diagnosis CodeableReference reshaping, and reason/diagnosis semantic split. Main uncertainty is official rationale and preferred migration guidance for diagnosis role/rank.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Apply explicit property renames, wrap old diagnosis Condition references as R6 CodeableReference arrays, classify old diagnosis data into reason/diagnosis/both, and decide how to preserve billing rank via Account or extensions. Backward conversion is lossy for Group subjects, code-only CodeableReferences, non-Condition reasons, and multiple diagnosis uses.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: High confidence for structural deltas from direct StructureDefinition comparison. Medium confidence for intent and terminology normalization because official narrative diffs, Jira notes, and full terminology expansions were not supplied.

compatibilityLeverage.note: Resource-level leverage is a planning signal. It does not mark individual Revisit findings as justified or unimportant.

rationaleMd:
EpisodeOfCare keeps its resource identity. The aggregate has 5 hard R4-to-R6 instance break(s), 1 potential hard break(s), 3 non-mechanical migration finding(s), and 0 direct behavior/API finding(s).

R4 maturity context is trial-use/FMM 2, which creates neutral stability pressure.

The computed migration-unavoidability score is 70/100, producing migration shape `moderate-targeted-remodel`, major migration `Partial`, and compatibility posture `preserve-where-low-cost-but-expect-resource-migration`.

6 finding(s) identify a yes/partial less-breaking base-design alternative, so the aggregate should not be used to dismiss local avoidability review.

11 shared Resource/DomainResource behavior finding(s) are listed as context but not scored for this resource to avoid duplicating base behavior issues across all resources.
recommendedStandardsPostureMd: Expect targeted migration work, but continue reviewing individual breaks. Use less-breaking designs where they do not preserve obsolete or conflicting models indefinitely.

topFindings.title: Required patient was renamed to required subject and widened to Patient or Group
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid plus runtime/API/codegen: R4 JSON with `patient` lacks required R6 `subject`; generated models and FHIRPath paths change. R6 Group subjects also create an R6-to-R4 loss case.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: diagnosis.rank was removed from EpisodeOfCare
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid with R4-to-R6 data-loss risk: R4 instances containing `diagnosis.rank` have an undefined R6 property, and the related Account sequence is outside the EpisodeOfCare resource and requires policy-driven migration.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: team was renamed to careTeam
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid plus runtime/API/codegen: R4 instances with `team` are not valid R6 at that path, and code or FHIRPath expressions using `EpisodeOfCare.team` must be renamed.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: diagnosis.role was replaced by repeating diagnosis.use with a different preferred ValueSet
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid plus runtime/API/codegen: an R4 `diagnosis.role` property is not recognized at the R6 path, and generated code or FHIRPath rules using `role` must change. The terminology change is mostly semantic/conformance pressure because the binding remains preferred.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: diagnosis.condition changed from one required Reference to repeating CodeableReference
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid with R6-to-R4 loss: an R4 Reference at `diagnosis.condition` is not the R6 array-of-CodeableReference shape, while R6 concept-only or multiple conditions cannot be represented faithfully as one R4 Condition reference.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R4 diagnosis semantics split between R6 reason and diagnosis
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: semantic/documentation with R6-to-R4 loss: structurally valid transforms can carry the wrong meaning, and R6 non-Condition or concept-only reasons have no native R4 EpisodeOfCare diagnosis slot.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.
